confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough bounded estimates. Hampi-specific sources are undated or pre-rupee-inflation guides, and beer and cappuccino figures lean on national aggregator and SEO data, not Hampi venues. Cocktail and wine anchors draw on hotel menus outside Hampi, and the wine glass anchor is inferred from the beer benchmark. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX: the 0.6976 value is a third-party report of the RBA 3 Nov 2026 reference rate. The rba.gov.au page was not successfully read for this value, and it is not confirmed as the latest observation available on 2026-11-19.
comparable_city_reasoning: Hampi is a small tourist town in Karnataka. Food and drink anchors were benchmarked against Indian national aggregator averages and Hampi-specific budget guides, with cocktail and wine cross-checked against 2026 Indian bar and hotel menu reports and the beer benchmark. Accommodation was estimated from general knowledge of small-town Karnataka tourist lodging, not from any named comparable city or live data.
